description: Trace-level check: is the failing dependency (checkout -> quote) still producing errors since a given window start. Verifier-only.

configuration.query: FROM traces-*.otel-* | WHERE span.name == "checkout -> quote" AND status.code == "Error" AND @timestamp >= ?window_start | STATS bad = COUNT(*)

window_start.description: Start of the verification window, bound to the executor's receipt applied_at timestamp, not now-minus-N-minutes
